text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament to discuss unemployment in Tuesday session.
- Kuwaiti employees of the Kuwait Public Transport Company to be offered 10 to 15 percent of company shares at a discount. The firm is among state holdings earmarked for privatisation.
- Communications Ministry cuts rates for telephone calls to 36 countries.

- Finance Minister Nasser al-Rodhan to patronise a conference on legal aspects of privatisation in March. Over the past two years the state has sold its stake in some 18 local firms for over $2 billion in the first phase of a privatisation plan.
- Parliament to take a three-week holiday in February.

- Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah receives closing account for 1995/96 state budget. Mainly due to high world oil prices, Kuwait halved a forecast deficit of 1.32 billion dinars ($4.42 billion) in the fiscal year which ended June 30, 1996.
